info.title: AgroSense MVP API and JSON reference
info.description: Five-table hackathon reference; routes are not implemented by this document. Schema components also define all stored JSONB shapes. Cross-field and transactional invariants are normative in domain-model.md.

200.description: One consistent data snapshot; stale data may still return 200.

400.description: Malformed JSON/path, unsupported body/query, or unknown property.

404.description: Farm, plot, or active cycle not found or not accessible.

413.description: Request, normalized dataset, or dashboard exceeds an MVP limit.

post.summary: Refresh the farm using its configured data mode
post.description: No request body or query parameters. Does not switch demo/live mode. Synchronous, bounded work; no 202/job ID. Success means the entire result committed. All responses use Cache-Control: private, no-store.

400.description: Malformed JSON/path, unsupported body/query, or unknown property.

404.description: Farm, plot, or active cycle not found or not accessible.

409.description: Farm version changed, or provider data is older than the stored forecast.

413.description: Request, normalized dataset, or dashboard exceeds an MVP limit.

429.description: Manual refresh rate limit; Retry-After seconds returned.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until next allowed manual attempt.

503.description: Refresh failed; previous successful data remains available.

patch.summary: Edit the seeded active crop cycle

200.description: Cultivation saved and farm version incremented.

400.description: Malformed JSON/path, unsupported body/query, or unknown property.

404.description: Farm, plot, or active cycle not found or not accessible.

409.description: Farm version changed, or provider data is older than the stored forecast.

413.description: Request, normalized dataset, or dashboard exceeds an MVP limit.

422.description: Invalid field or merged cultivation state.

Instant.description: UTC RFC3339 instant, always serialized with Z.

Polygon.description: MVP: one exterior ring, no holes. First and last coordinate must match; topology is checked at seed import.

Source.description: issuedAt is actual provider issuance, null when unknown; never synthesize it from retrieval time.

ForecastHour.description: Hour interval [at, at+1h); air temperature at 2 m. Missing provider temperatures invalidate a complete refresh.

ForecastSummary.description: Exact farms.forecast_summary JSON. Unique plot IDs; equal complete hourly windows for all plots; fetchedAt=max(source.retrievedAt). Cross-field checks are defined in domain-model.md.

EventEvidence.description: Exact events.evidence JSON. One UTC calendar date. Include all available forecast hours for that date, including above-zero values.

InputSnapshot.description: Exact plot_alerts.input_snapshot JSON. cropCycle/event/plot IDs must match referenced rows at publication; immutable evidence within a replaceable current result.

tileUrlTemplate.description: Configured browser-safe HTTPS template with literal {z}, {x}, {y}; no server secret.

DashboardResponse.description: Full dashboard. Every property is present; missing values use null. Selection/filtering and map bounds are computed client-side from this bounded response.

alerts.reason: Escenario sintético: la regla demo-maize-v6 coincide.
alerts.recommendation: Demostración: revisar el lote; no es asesoramiento agronómico.

UpdateCropCycleRequest.description: PATCH only the seeded open cycle. Omitted fields remain unchanged; null clears nullable fields. Validate the merged cycle. Sending either stage field requires both. Changing crop requires both stage fields explicitly, with compatible values or null.

error.message: Farm data changed. Reload and retry.
